title: Better Business Bureau 20/20 Investigation
summary: An ABC 20/20 investigation into whether the Better Business Bureau sells its ratings. It looks at BBB finances, executive pay and how grades relate to paid accreditation.
why: HN commenters cite it as evidence that the BBB is a pay-to-play shakedown whenever BBB ratings or accreditation come up.

quote.text: Watch the whole video if you haven't seen it before.
